description: This file defines the CustomerApproval class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Customer namespace. It contains methods to manage customer approval records, including retrieving, approving, denying, and deleting approvals, as well as handling related affiliate approvals.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Model class for handling customer approval operations in the admin module of OpenCart.

methods.name: deleteApprovalsByCustomerId
methods.description: Deletes all approval records for a specific customer by ID.

methods.name: getCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer approval records based on filter criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerApproval
methods.description: Fetches a single customer approval record by its ID.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerApprovals
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer approval records matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: approveCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer status to approved (active) and removes pending approval records.

methods.name: denyCustomer
methods.description: Removes pending approval record for a customer, effectively denying approval.

methods.name: approveAffiliate
methods.description: Approves a customer's affiliate status and removes pending approval records.

methods.name: denyAffiliate
methods.description: Removes pending affiliate approval for a customer.
